name: Rotate an image without distortion
short_description: Rotate an image without distortion once under stated everyday conditions without assistance.
self_assessment: I can rotate an image without distortion in one repeatable attempt without help.
description: Rotate an image without distortion means carrying out this capability under ordinary, stated conditions without another person completing any part. Practice focuses on the observable result, the threshold in the self-assessment, and repeatability across more than one occasion. The capability includes selecting an appropriate approach, completing the action, and checking the outcome. It excludes brand-specific steps, credentials, unrelated habits, and one-off achievements.
examples: Rotate an image without distortion in a fresh real-life scenario.
